_readme: Hand-maintained. Places Srini has physically been, for work, study, or to present. NOT generated from talks.html or publications.html and not safe to regenerate from them: some listed talks were virtual, some were presented by co-authors, and no conference paper records a city anywhere. Conference-paper travel is INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN and grows only as Srini recalls a trip; absence of a paper here is not evidence he skipped it. 'mode':'virtual' rows are kept for the record and must be filtered out of any map. 'confirmed':false rows are unverified guesses awaiting confirmation. Excluded on purpose, do not re-add: 2024 CSTE Pittsburgh, 2026 SIAM Life Sciences Cleveland, KDD 2016, Epidemics 2023, MIDAS Annual Meeting 2024, NACCHO Preparedness Summit 2022, and the 2020 virtual talks (Intelligent Health, PPFST, vector-borne workshop, GMU panel).
_schema: city, country, lat/lon (approximate city centroid, 2dp), start/end as YYYY-MM (end null for point events), kind (education|work|talk|conference|service), purpose, mode (in-person|virtual), confirmed, ref. Sorted by start ascending; append a recalled trip by inserting one object in date order.
